camel_example: aliyun ossutil api list-access-points-for-object-process --region cn-hangzhou --continuation-token abc --max-keys 10
description_en: Retrieves user-level Object FC Access Point information
description_zh: 获取用户级别的对象FC接入点信息
name: ListAccessPointsForObjectProcess

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of Object FC Access Points to return.

Valid values: greater than 0 and less than or equal to 1000.

If the results cannot be completely listed at a time due to the max-keys setting, the response includes a `<NextContinuationToken>` element as the continuation-token for the next listing operation
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回对象FC接入点的最大数量。

取值：大于0小于等于1000。

如果因为max-keys的设置无法一次完成列举，返回结果会附加一个`<NextContinuationToken>`作为下一次列举的continuation-token
parameters.name: max_keys

parameters.help_en: The token from which the List operation must start. You can obtain this token from NextContinuationToken in the response
parameters.help_zh: 指定List操作需要从此token开始。您可以从返回结果中的NextContinuationToken获取此token
parameters.name: continuation_token

ListAccessPointsForObjectProcessResult.description_en: The container that stores the results of this Object FC Access Point listing operation
ListAccessPointsForObjectProcessResult.description_zh: 保存本次列举对象FC接入点信息结果的容器

AccessPointsForObjectProcess.description_en: The container that stores information about all Object FC Access Points
AccessPointsForObjectProcess.description_zh: 保存所有对象FC接入点信息的容器

AccessPointForObjectProcess.description_en: The container that stores information about a single Object FC Access Point
AccessPointForObjectProcess.description_zh: 保存单个对象FC接入点信息的容器

items.description_en: The container that stores information about a single Object FC Access Point
items.description_zh: 保存单个对象FC接入点信息的容器

AccessPointForObjectProcessAlias.description_en: The alias of the Object FC Access Point

AccessPointName.description_en: The name of the access point

AccessPointNameForObjectProcess.description_en: The name of the Object FC Access Point

AllowAnonymousAccessForObjectProcess.description_en:
Indicates whether anonymous access is allowed.

After you enable this option, anonymous accounts are allowed to access your bucket through the Object FC Access Point, which incurs fees
AllowAnonymousAccessForObjectProcess.description_zh:
是否允许匿名访问。

开启该选项之后将会允许匿名账号通过ObjectFC接入点访问您的Bucket，会产生相关费用

Status.description_en:
The status of the Object FC Access Point. Valid values:

enable: The Object FC Access Point is created.
disable: The Object FC Access Point is disabled.
creating: The Object FC Access Point is being created.
deleting: The Object FC Access Point is deleted
Status.description_zh:
对象FC接入点所处状态。返回值如下：

enable：对象FC接入点已创建完成。
disable：对象FC接入点已禁用。
creating：对象FC接入点正在创建中。
deleting：对象FC接入点已删除

AccountId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the Object FC Access Point belongs
AccountId.description_zh: 对象FC接入点所属的阿里云账号UID

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the results returned in the request are truncated. Valid values:

true: Not all results are returned in this request.
false: All results are returned in this request
IsTruncated.description_zh:
请求中返回的结果是否被截断。返回值如下：

true：表示本次未返回全部结果。
false：表示本次已返回全部结果

NextContinuationToken.description_en: Indicates that this ListAccessPointsForObjectProcess request contains subsequent results. Specify NextContinuationToken as the continuation-token to continue retrieving results
NextContinuationToken.description_zh: 表明本次ListAccessPointsForObjectProcess请求包含后续结果，需要将NextContinuationToken指定为continuation-token继续获取结果
